bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
src=fac6bfd5b1ec38809368d3a3097001d0080eace7
oldhash=aa41c17ad84a017f76959053184541be005997a64b2affe0bfd628532d29ce1c
newhash=bf3ace0a37071c32d08a1478994cc969eff2578b28383c529b4cd57b1288034a
oldid=sha256:2b609f16dd4544df54c119d7b380cf13787513062aaa36f718a28ba389082341
localtag=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
newtag=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:profile-dm-fac6bfd
rollback=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:rollback-profile-dm-20261127
test "$(gh run view 45956216691 -R seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --json headSha,conclusion --jq '.headSha+" "+.conclusion')" = "$src success"
test "$(gh run view 45956216767 -R seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --json headSha,conclusion --jq '.headSha+" "+.conclusion')" = "$src success"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$oldid"
test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$localtag")" = "$oldid"
test "$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sha256sum /app/gaybbs.mjs | cut -d ' ' -f1)" = "$oldhash"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled
test -f "$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml"
tmp="$(mktemp -d)"
swapped=0
ok=0
cleanup(){
 rc=$?
 trap - EXIT
 if test "$swapped" = 1 && test "$ok" != 1; then
  docker tag "$rollback" "$localtag" && docker compose -p deploy -f "$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
 fi
 rm -rf "$tmp"
 exit "$rc"
}
trap cleanup EXIT
gh run download 45956216767 -R seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot -n gaybbs-profile-bundle -D "$tmp"
test "$(sha256sum "$tmp/gaybbs.mjs" | cut -d ' ' -f1)" = "$newhash"
docker run --rm --network none -v "$tmp:/bundle:ro" --entrypoint node "$localtag" --check /bundle/gaybbs.mjs
cat > "$tmp/Dockerfile" <<'DOCKER'
FROM gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
COPY --chown=1000:1000 gaybbs.mjs /app/gaybbs.mjs
DOCKER
docker build --network none --pull=false -t "$newtag" -f "$tmp/Dockerfile" "$tmp" >/dev/null
newid="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$newtag")"
test "$newid" != "$oldid"
docker tag "$oldid" "$rollback"
docker tag "$newid" "$localtag"
swapped=1
docker compose -p deploy -f "$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null
ready=0
for i in $(seq 1 18); do
 if docker logs --tail 240 deploy-gaybbs-1 2>&1 | grep -F 'GAYBBS_BOT_READY' >/dev/null; then ready=1; break; fi
 sleep 5
done
test "$ready" = 1
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$newid"
test "$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sha256sum /app/gaybbs.mjs | cut -d ' ' -f1)" = "$newhash"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled
ok=1
echo PROFILE_DM_REPAIR_DEPLOY=PASS
echo BOT_BUNDLE_READBACK=PASS
echo USERBOT_SESSION_SERVICE=PASS
echo ORIGINAL_POSTS_UNCHANGED_BY_DEPLOY=PASS
echo ROLLBACK_IMAGE_RETAINED=PASS
